verdict.rationale: v0's docs describe robust two-way GitHub sync: connecting a project to a repo, working on isolated branches, previewing, running CI, publishing via PRs, importing existing GitHub code, and resolving conflicts/CI failures directly from v0 (v0-docs-2,3,26,27,30,39). This covers both directions of the sync story (v0→GitHub via branches/PRs, GitHub→v0 via import) with first-party specificity. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community verification that the bidirectional sync works reliably in practice beyond vendor docs.
